numeric.purpose: Prices, FPS, and cost per FPS use tabular numerals.

shadows.name: chart-tooltip
shadows.purpose: Separate transient chart details from the plot.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Animation and transition duration override under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Filled primary action with contrasting keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--link, #b6ed8a); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--link, #b6ed8a); color: var(--on-accent, #101413); font: 500 1rem var(--font-ui, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--link-hover, #cef7b0); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--link, #b6ed8a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected navigation
components.description: Current route in the persistent desktop navigation.
components.html: Overview
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 46px; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 8px; background: #293629; color: var(--link, #b6ed8a); font: 500 .875rem var(--font-ui, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--link, #b6ed8a); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav:hover { text-decoration: none; }

narrative.overview: The implemented direction uses compact navigation, restrained panels, and clear numerical hierarchy to compare GPU price and performance. This descriptive name records the implementation; it is not a claim of a separately approved brand metaphor.

rules.name: The Context Rule
rules.body: Value colors never replace accompanying labels, thresholds, or the below-minimum state.

dos: Preserve keyboard focus, estimate labels, price dates, and sources.
Synchronize chart and shortlist with the selected view.
donts: Do not substitute vendor colors for value ratings.
Do not present price snapshots as live quotes.
Do not ship reference screenshots as artwork.
